subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: After green exact-head macOS CI, must this grouped dependency update also pass signed packaged-app smoke for Sparkle updater activation and representative Peekaboo bridge/computer-action startup?
rationale: The source update is compatible and CI-clean, but its highest-risk production paths depend on signing and macOS accessibility or automation permissions that the focused build-and-test lane cannot fully prove.

options.title: Require packaged smoke
options.body: Verify updater activation and representative Peekaboo startup in a correctly signed packaged app before merge.

options.title: Accept exact-head CI
options.body: Merge after a refreshed green head while explicitly accepting residual signed-runtime uncertainty.

options.title: Split sensitive pins
options.body: Separate Sparkle and Peekaboo so each runtime-sensitive upgrade can be validated and rolled back independently.

recommendation.title: Require packaged smoke
recommendation.body: Verify updater activation and representative Peekaboo startup in a correctly signed packaged app before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository history and upstream ownership converge on the macOS app, Sparkle integration, and Peekaboo runtime boundary.
